prompt: Create an ultra-realistic professional lifestyle portrait of a young adult Black man executive with short black hair, clean-shaven face, calm confident expression, and direct eye contact seated behind a polished wooden executive desk in a modern office. He sits upright in a tall black leather office chair, wearing a crisp white dress shirt, a navy blue tie with small white dots, and a black wristwatch. His right hand writes with a black pen on a small yellow sticky note, while his left hand holds a black corded telephone handset to his ear; the coiled phone cable stretches diagonally toward the right side of the desk. The mood is focused, disciplined, and businesslike, as if he is taking an important call while planning the day. Use a vertical portrait composition, realistic lens perspective, sharp facial detail, natural office lighting, subtle depth of field, and rich warm wood tones. On the desk include exactly 6 visible item groups: 1 black ceramic mug printed with the three stacked words “Discipline / Focus / Execution,” 1 calculator, 1 stack of multicolor sticky notes with blue, pink, yellow, and green layers, 1 small yellow sticky-note pad being written on, 1 clipboard with a document titled “BUSINESS PLAN” showing charts and lines, and 1 open silver laptop cropped on the right. Behind him, create a matte charcoal gray wall with a white lion-head crown logo and the brand text FACELESS CONTENT on the left. Add exactly 4 colorful square sticky notes on the wall: yellow note reading “PLAN - FOCUS - EXECUTE,” blue note reading “DISCIPLINE TODAY SUCCESS TOMORROW,” pink note reading “BE BETTER THAN YESTERDAY,” and green note reading “HARD WORK BEATS TALENT.” Add exactly 1 white daily checklist sheet pinned to the wall, titled DAILY CHECKLIST, with 5 checked items: MEETING, CALLS, EMAILS, PLANNING, FOLLOW UP. On the right side of the background include a wooden bookcase with binders, books, a small potted plant, and a black globe-like decor object. Keep the image photorealistic, clean, polished, motivational, and corporate; avoid cartoon styling, exaggerated facial features, clutter, extra people, distorted hands, unreadable main text, or watermarks.

promptZh: 创作一张超写实的专业生活方式肖像，画面中 一位留着黑色短发、面容清爽、神情冷静自信且目光直视镜头的年轻黑人男性高管 坐在现代办公室里一张光洁的木质行政办公桌后。他坐姿端正，坐在一把高靠背黑色皮质办公椅上，身穿 一件挺括的白色衬衫，搭配一条带有白色小圆点的海军蓝领带，并佩戴一块黑色腕表。他的右手正用一支黑色钢笔在一张黄色便签纸上书写，左手将黑色有线电话听筒贴在耳边；电话线呈对角线延伸至办公桌右侧。氛围专注、严谨且具有商务感，仿佛他正在规划日程的同时接听重要电话。采用竖构图，使用写实的镜头视角，面部细节清晰，呈现自然的办公室光影、微妙的景深效果以及浓郁的暖色木质调。办公桌上需包含 6 组清晰可见的物品：1 个印有“Discipline / Focus / Execution”三行堆叠文字的黑色陶瓷马克杯、1 台计算器、1 叠包含蓝、粉、黄、绿多色的便签纸、1 张正在书写的黄色便签纸、1 个带有标题为“BUSINESS PLAN”且显示图表和线条文档的剪贴板，以及 1 台在右侧被截取的银色笔记本电脑。在他身后，设置一面哑光炭灰色墙壁，左侧印有白色狮头皇冠标志和品牌文字 FACELESS CONTENT。在墙上添加 4 张彩色方形便签纸：黄色便签写着“PLAN - FOCUS - EXECUTE”，蓝色便签写着“DISCIPLINE TODAY SUCCESS TOMORROW”，粉色便签写着“BE BETTER THAN YESTERDAY”，绿色便签写着“HARD WORK BEATS TALENT”。在墙上钉上 1 张白色的每日清单表，标题为 DAILY CHECKLIST，包含 5 个已勾选的项目：MEETING, CALLS, EMAILS, PLANNING, FOLLOW UP。背景右侧放置一个木质书架，上面摆放着活页夹、书籍、一盆小绿植以及一个黑色的球状装饰物。保持图像照片级真实、整洁、精致、励志且具有企业感；避免卡通风格、夸张的面部特征、杂乱、多余的人物、扭曲的手部、无法辨认的主要文字或水印。
